sources.title: Senate committee sets key vote for Trump FDA nominee
STAT+: Cassidy sets key vote on Overton, even as he remains undecided on nominee to lead FDA

en.title: Senate committee schedules vote on FDA commissioner nominee
en.dek: Senate Health committee sets vote for Heidi Overton on November 18
facts: The Senate health committee scheduled a vote for Heidi Overton's nomination as FDA commissioner on November 18 according to a committee press release.
Committee Chair Bill Cassidy stated he remained undecided on Overton's nomination in a post on X.
The committee will also vote on James O’Neill’s nomination to serve as director of the National Science Foundation.
If the committee vote passes, Overton’s nomination would proceed to the full Senate according to STAT News.
body: The Senate health committee scheduled a vote for Heidi Overton's nomination to serve as commissioner of the Food and Drug Administration on November 18, according to a committee press release.
Committee Chair Bill Cassidy stated he remained undecided on Overton, he wrote in a post on X.
The committee will also vote on James O’Neill’s nomination to serve as director of the National Science Foundation and three other nominations.
en.context: Republicans are racing to confirm nominees before Democrats take power in January, according to STAT News.

de.title: Senatsausschuss terminiert Abstimmung über FDA-Kommissarin-Kandidatin
de.dek: Senats-Gesundheitsausschuss legt Abstimmung für Heidi Overton am 18. November fest
facts: Senats-Gesundheitsausschuss anberaumte Abstimmung über Heidis Overton Nominierung als FDA-Kommissarin am 18. November laut Pressemitteilung des Ausschusses
Ausschussvorsitzender Bill Cassidy blieb in einem Post auf X über Overton’s Nominierung unentschlossen
Ausschuss stimmt auch über James O’Neill Nominierung für Direktor des National Science Foundation ab
Wenn der Ausschussabstimmung zustimmt, würde Overton’s Nominierung zum vollen Senat gemäß STAT News weitergeleitet
body: Der Senatsausschuss für Gesundheit hat die Abstimmung über die Nominierung von Heidi Overton zur Kommissarin der Food and Drug Administration für den 18. November angesetzt, wie in einer Pressemitteilung des Ausschusses mitgeteilt wurde.
Ausschussvorsitzender Bill Cassidy erklärte in einem Beitrag auf X, er sei bezüglich Overton noch unentschlossen.
Der Ausschuss wird zudem über die Nominierung von James O’Neill zum Direktor der National Science Foundation sowie über drei weitere Nominierungen abstimmen.
de.context: Republikaner eilen, Nominees vor Machtübernahme der Demokraten im Januar zu bestätigen, laut STAT News

fr.title: Comité du Sénat : vote prévu sur la nomination de Heidi Overton à la FDA le 18 novembre
fr.dek: Le comité de la santé du Sénat fixe le scrutin pour Heidi Overton au 18 novembre
facts: Le comité sénatorial de la santé a programmé un vote sur la nomination de Heidi Overton au poste de commissaire de la FDA pour le 18 novembre, selon un communiqué du comité.
Le président du comité, Bill Cassidy, a déclaré sur X qu'il restait indécis sur la nomination d'Overton.
Le comité votera également sur la nomination de James O’Neill au poste de directeur de la National Science Foundation.
Si le vote du comité aboutit, la nomination d'Overton sera transmise au Sénat complet, selon STAT News.
body: Le comité du Sénat a programmé un vote sur la nomination d'Heidi Overton au poste de commissaire de la Food and Drug Administration le 18 novembre, selon un communiqué de presse du comité.
Le président du comité, Bill Cassidy, a indiqué sur X qu'il restait indécis concernant Overton.
Le comité votera également sur la nomination de James O’Neill au poste de directeur de la National Science Foundation ainsi que sur trois autres nominations.
fr.context: Les républicains s'efforcent de confirmer les nominations avant que les démocrates ne reprennent le pouvoir en janvier, selon STAT News.

problemsFixed: The headline uses loaded language ('Trump nominee') which is not directly supported as a fact in the provided sources, only that she is a nominee for the FDA commissioner role.
The dek is not a factual statement of what happened and uses loaded framing.

The fact 'Republicans hold a narrow majority on the committee, with one Republican vote potentially deciding Overton's fate' is an interpretation/speculation based on the text 'It would take just one Republican on the committee to sink her nomination, assuming all Democrats vote against her,' which requires careful attribution and framing, not presentation as a fact.

The body contains speculative language ('pivotal step') and an unsupported prediction about Democrats taking power in January (S2 mentions Republicans racing to confirm before Democrats take power in January, but this is not stated as a fact by the sources, only as context for the race).
The context makes an unsupported prediction about Democrats taking power in January.
The body structure is weak; the second paragraph contains multiple ideas without proper flow and ends with an evaluative summary ('The committee vote represents a pivotal step...').
